deliverable: Executive EcoHVAC Guardian pitch: business opportunity, shared-HVAC value problem, Digital Twin functions, conditional future potential, and governed pilot decision
claim_boundary: Closed-loop four-room classroom simulation Digital Twin with illustrative economics. Physical integration, measured facility outcomes, field model validation, production security, and deployment authority require separate evidence.

generation.generator: Node.js + self-contained HTML/CSS/images + headless Google Chrome

slides.title: Turn shared HVAC from a hidden trade-off into a visible, governable business decision
slides.claim: EcoHVAC Guardian is presented as an evidence-building opportunity to test business value, occupant outcomes and trustworthy expansion before operational authority increases.
slides.limitation: The opening is a pitch proposition for a governed classroom simulation and illustrative business case—not a measured outcome, approved investment or deployment authorization.

slides.title: A shared AHU turns separate room demands into one comfort, reliability and cost decision
slides.claim: The business problem is cross-zone consequence: four instantiated simulated room twins share one finite-capacity AHU, so local demands affect comfort, equipment state and cost across the ecosystem.
slides.limitation: The screenshot is current simulated UI/state evidence, not a connected physical building or field-synchronization result.

slides.title: The modeled value case lives or dies on avoided incidents—not energy savings alone
slides.claim: The illustrative base case yields S$9,080 annual net value and 33.04-month payback, but approximately 91.74% of gross modeled benefit comes from assumed avoided incidents.
slides.limitation: All values are editable scenarios—not measured savings, forecasts, quotations, realized ROI or an approved investment.

slides.title: The Digital Twin converts a shared constraint into a closed operating loop
slides.claim: Persistent ecosystem state connects mirror, predict, coordinate, respond and verify functions beneath the Operations Centre interface.
slides.current_boundary: The current source instantiates four rooms, while ROOM_IDS and parts of MQTT room command/status plumbing remain two-room.
slides.limitation: Current UI/state visibility does not establish symmetric four-room remote commandability or physical-building operation.

slides.title: The twin records what airflow was actually granted—not merely what each room requested
slides.claim: An archived two-room MQTT trace demonstrates correlated command acceptance, finite-capacity grants, bounded comfort-debt memory, actuator feedback, pause behavior and deterministic reset.
slides.limitation: The archived two-room trace is explicitly separate from the current four-room screenshots and does not prove universal fairness or one immutable release.

slides.title: The twin projects what may happen next—and abstains outside supported inputs
slides.claim: The current predictive UI presents four-room +5/+15-minute trajectories, explicit OOD/abstention behavior, a 15-tick simulated evaluation lifecycle and archived software-test evidence.
slides.limitation: Thermal projections are deterministic teaching-model continuations; fan-risk data are synthetic; software tests do not establish field performance or physical safety.

slides.title: Trust is an operating function: expose who waits, preserve human authority and secure every step
slides.claim: The trust envelope combines observable benefit/burden signals, aggregate-occupancy purpose limits, acknowledged human authority, simulation stop controls, and current-versus-target cybersecurity.
slides.purpose_boundary: Aggregate occupancy supports HVAC decisions and must not become identity, attendance, productivity or disciplinary profiling.
slides.limitation: Synthetic false negatives are not field failures; local audit is not immutable; hardened identity/TLS/ACL/recovery controls are targets, not deployed evidence.

slides.title: Operational authority can expand only as evidence, safeguards and accountability mature
slides.claim: Conditional future potential progresses from simulation to read-only shadow, human-reviewed advice, bounded reversible control and separately governed site scale.
slides.limitation: No schedule, budget, facility approval, physical autonomy, site-scale outcome or deployment authorization is asserted.

slides.title: Approve an evidence-building pilot—not autonomous deployment
slides.claim: The proposed decision is to prove value, protect people and earn trust, with advance to read-only shadow, redesign or stop as evidence-based exits.
slides.limitation: No pilot amount, schedule, owner, signatory, facility authorization, production deployment or physical autonomy is asserted.
